decision.title: Decision model
decision.description: Pick a decision model and where it applies. Off: every scenario takes its default path.

decision.jevHint: The selected System One model decides each step in the browser.

memory.title: Long-term memory
memory.modelDesc: Reads conversations and consolidates memory with this model.

memory.filesDesc: Markdown files on this computer. Turning memory off does not delete them.
